about: Views scripts/preview.sh screenshots after a draft render, each beside its reference photo. Aim with yaw/pitch (compass degrees, clockwise from north; pitch up is positive), or hotspot (a slug), plus an optional turn (drag px). fov is vertical degrees (the site opens at 75). ref is a photo path: absolute, ~/..., or relative to the main checkout's private starter/ folder. The site clamps yaw so the frame stays inside the viewpoint's yaw range.
